run_remote_client_cli: run the SWERL remote client CLI by piping a JSON payload with method, args, and kwargs to stdin
run_get_new_id: run the remote client CLI to call get_new_id and retrieve a new session ID from the server
run_run_command: run the remote client CLI to call run_command and execute a command on the remote server
run_create_session: run the remote client CLI to call create_session and create a new session with command arguments
run_stop_session: run the remote client CLI to call stop_session and terminate an existing session by session ID
